interpretation: Each of two ~63-second baseline runs showed 31 individual >1000ms Windows DirectDraw Blt calls while none of the periods outside DirectDraw_Flip were >1000ms. API-side durations do not prove visible frame rate or isolate the cause inside Wine.
important_limits: A repeated baseline is not an A/B improvement. The original nonblocking experiment was inconclusive. Do not assume a driver root cause or invent speedups.

cpu_probe.interpretation: In two approved Mac TEST runs, virtually all sampled >1000ms DirectDraw Blt calls consumed substantial reported calling-thread CPU time; an idle wait alone is not supported. The thread CPU sample and Blt wall timing scopes differ slightly; the CPU probe is diagnostic, not attribution to Wine, GPU, or driver, and does not establish displayed FPS.
